key_values.event_name: 2021 Caldor Fire near South Lake Tahoe

acceptable_variants: Equivalent short labels are acceptable if all ledgers and flags match.
primary_gt.canonical_summary: Major structure-loss and long-progression thresholds are true; responder-heavy injury and late-tail flags are also true.
overreach_limits: Do not infer exact deaths, economic loss, road damage, or shelter totals.
Do not treat the post-visualization tail as a measured spread interval.
required_elements: 2021-08-14 to 2021-10-21 is 68 elapsed days, matching the active-day value
2021-08-15 to 2021-10-06 gives 52 days, 104 12-hour intervals, and 15 tail days

criteria.description: Gives the expected short label or an equivalent label that states major structure loss with a long progression record.
criteria.name: Final numeric diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a label that captures only the structure-loss or duration component.

criteria.description: Reports 1,005 destroyed, 81 damaged, 1,086 affected structures, and destruction share about 0.925.
criteria.name: Structure ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct structure count or share; allow small rounding differences for the share.

criteria.description: Reports 5 civilian injuries, 16 firefighter injuries, 21 total confirmed injuries, and firefighter share about 0.762.
criteria.name: Injury ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the injury total, 1 point for the component counts, and 1 point for the share.

criteria.description: Reconstructs 68 elapsed event-window days, 52 visualization-span days, 104 12-hour intervals, and a 15-day tail to containment.
criteria.name: Window reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct date-derived value.

criteria.description: Sets all four threshold flags to true using the stated cutoffs and the computed values.
criteria.name: Threshold ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award proportional credit for correct flags with clear arithmetic support.

criteria.description: Shows enough arithmetic or date math to make the totals, shares, intervals, and tail reproducible.
criteria.name: Formula consistency
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for partial formulas or formulas without clear units.

criteria.description: Returns concise JSON with the requested ledger fields and stays within the computed values.
criteria.name: Compact structured output
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for clear content with minor formatting defects.
